name: Yoshizawa Akio
source:
The third son of the Yoshizawa family and Natsuo's younger brother. Even though he pretends to be an angelic boy, he's actually quite malicious. According to Natsuo, his personality changes when he gets angry. He's in charge of cooking for the Yoshizawa family.
